title: Secure SDLC
description: Change-management controls for application delivery: branch protection, required reviews, self-merge prevention, and production deployment approvals across connected GitHub and GitLab evidence.
guidance: Auditors sample SDLC process evidence — not source code. Vigil verifies branch protection, merge request approvals, environment protection, and security scanning metadata from connected Git providers.

title: Identity Governance & Access Review
description: Stale and over-privileged identity signals across AWS IAM and connected GitHub/GitLab organizations — inactive users, unused credentials, root posture, and org MFA enforcement.
guidance: Covers automated evidence Vigil can collect without HR/IdP integration. Terminated-employee removal and periodic attestation remain manual gaps.

title: Change Management
description: Authorized change controls: required pull-request reviews, blocked direct pushes and self-merges on protected branches, plus retained infrastructure audit trails via CloudTrail.
guidance: Auditors sample change-management process evidence — branch protection and merge approvals from Git providers, plus CloudTrail retention for infrastructure changes.

title: Container Vulnerability Monitoring
description: Continuous vulnerability scanning evidence for container workloads — Amazon Inspector coverage (ECR, EC2, Lambda), ECR scan-on-push, enhanced registry scanning, and active critical findings.
guidance: Auditors care that image and runtime vulnerabilities are tracked and remediated — not a specific vendor product. Wording avoids naming Inspector directly in customer-facing findings.

title: Logging & Monitoring
description: Centralized audit logging, tamper-resistant CloudTrail delivery, threat detection via GuardDuty, and configuration change tracking via AWS Config.
guidance: Roll-up of CC7 evidence signals. Individual CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and Config checks remain authoritative; this composite answers whether logging and monitoring controls are operating.

title: Backup & Data Resilience
description: Backup posture and data-loss prevention: automated RDS backups, deletion protection, DynamoDB point-in-time recovery, and no publicly accessible snapshots.
guidance: Covers recoverability and accidental-exposure risks Vigil can verify agentlessly. Does not replace restore-test attestation or documented RPO/RTO.
